title: Preserve the subject of follow-up questions.
comment:
**Preserve the subject of follow-up questions.**

The handler accepts conversation history but sends only `last["content"]` to `answerer`. After a question about Project A, a follow-up such as “What is its deadline?” searches without “Project A”. If the store contains several projects, the bridge can return another project’s deadline or no answer. Use the relevant history to resolve the question, or reject follow-ups that the bridge cannot resolve.

title: Update extracted notes when the extraction changes.
comment:
**Update extracted notes when the extraction changes.**

If the same source text produces different validated notes on a later extraction, this call reaches `_import` with the same path and content hash. `_import` returns `duplicate=True` before saving the new rows or metadata. The reported extraction then differs from the evidence that search returns. Compare the extraction as well as the source text before treating an observation as a duplicate.

title: Handle connection resets during cloud requests.
comment:
**Handle connection resets during cloud requests.**

If the peer resets the connection while `response.read()` runs, `ConnectionResetError` escapes this handler. `main` does not catch it, so the CLI prints a traceback instead of its controlled service error. Include read-time `OSError` failures in the request error handling.
